# powerhmc_network_bridge (Resource)

Manages a NetworkBridge on an IBM Power Systems managed system, together with the set of
VirtualNetworks (IEEE 802.1Q VLANs) it exposes via Shared Ethernet Adapters (SEA)
on one or two VIOSes.

Both `virtual_network` and `sea` (Shared Ethernet Adapter) must always be configured together.
When `sea` is specified, exactly one virtual network must have
`tagged = false`, that network's VLAN ID becomes the bridge PVID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The powerhmc_network_bridge resource creates and manages a NetworkBridge
# (Shared Ethernet Adapter) and its associated VirtualNetworks on an IBM Power
# Systems managed system.
#
# Both `virtual_network` and `sea` must always be configured together.
# Exactly one virtual_network entry must have `tagged = false` — its VLAN ID
# becomes the bridge PVID.
#
# Import: terraform import powerhmc_network_bridge.<name> <system_name>/<bridge_pvid>
# (see import.sh)

##############################################
# Example 1: Basic bridge — single VIOS, one untagged + one tagged VN
##############################################
resource "powerhmc_network_bridge" "basic" {
  system_name = "managed-system"

  virtual_network = [
    {
      name           = "vn-untagged"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 145
      tagged         = false
    },
    {
      name           = "vn-tagged"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 200
      tagged         = true
    },
  ]

  sea {
    primary_vios {
      name            = "vios1"
      backing_adapter = "ent0"
    }
  }
}

##############################################
# Example 2: Bridge with failover (secondary VIOS)
##############################################
resource "powerhmc_network_bridge" "failover" {
  system_name = "managed-system"

  virtual_network = [
    {
      name           = "vn-untagged"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 145
      tagged         = false
    },
    {
      name           = "vn-app"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 300
      tagged         = true
    },
  ]

  sea {
    jumbo_frame = false
    large_send  = false
    qos_mode    = "disabled" # "disabled" | "strict" | "loose"

    primary_vios {
      name            = "vios1"
      backing_adapter = "ent0"
    }

    secondary_vios {
      name            = "vios2"
      backing_adapter = "ent0"
    }
  }
}

##############################################
# Example 3: Bridge with load sharing and explicit load groups
##############################################
resource "powerhmc_network_bridge" "load_sharing" {
  system_name = "managed-system"

  virtual_network = [
    {
      name           = "vn-untagged"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 145
      tagged         = false
    },
    {
      name           = "vn-app"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 200
      tagged         = true
    },
    {
      name           = "vn-db"
      virtual_switch = "ETHERNET0"
      vlan_id        = 300
      tagged         = true
    },
  ]

  sea {
    load_sharing = true

    # Each load_group maps a trunk-adapter port VLAN (pvid) to a set of
    # virtual networks (vlan_ids). The pvid must be distinct from all
    # virtual_network vlan_id values.
    load_group = [
      {
        pvid     = 50
        vlan_ids = [200]
      },
      {
        pvid     = 51
        vlan_ids = [300]
      },
    ]

    primary_vios {
      name            = "vios1"
      backing_adapter = "ent0"
    }

    secondary_vios {
      name            = "vios2"
      backing_adapter = "ent0"
    }
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "15m"
    update = "20m"
    delete = "10m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `system_name` (String) Name of the managed system.
- `virtual_network` (Attributes Set) Set of VirtualNetworks to create. `name` and `vlan_id` must be unique across all entries. When `sea` is configured, exactly one entry must have `tagged = false`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_network))

### Optional

- `sea` (Block, Optional) Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) configuration for the NetworkBridge. Requires `primary_vios`. Exactly one entry in `virtual_network` must have `tagged = false`, that network's VLAN ID is used as the bridge PVID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sea))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the NetworkBridge (used as Terraform resource ID).

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_network`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the virtual network (max 40 characters).
- `virtual_switch` (String) Name of the VirtualSwitch to bind this network to.
- `vlan_id` (Number) IEEE 802.1Q VLAN ID (1–4094).

Optional:

- `tagged` (Boolean) Whether the network uses IEEE 802.1Q tagged frames. Defaults to `true` when omitted. Set to `false` for exactly one entry to designate the untagged network whose VLAN ID becomes the bridge PVID.

Read-Only:

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the VirtualNetwork assigned by the HMC.
- `vswitch_id` (Number) Numeric VirtualSwitch ID returned by the HMC.


<a id="nestedblock--sea"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sea`

Optional:

- `jumbo_frame` (Boolean) Enable jumbo frames on the SEA. **Immutable**, changing this value will destroy and recreate the bridge.
- `large_send` (Boolean) Enable TCP large-send offload on the SEA.
- `load_group` (Attributes Set) Load groups for the NetworkBridge. Each entry specifies `pvid`, `primary_slot_number`, and `vlan_ids` (a set of virtual network VLAN IDs). Changing `pvid`, `primary_slot_number`, or `secondary_slot_number` on an existing load group will destroy that load group and create a new one with the new values. `vlan_ids` values must be unique across all load groups. Virtual networks not listed in any `vlan_ids` are placed in the default load group. When omitted, the provider preserves the current load group configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sea--load_group))
- `load_sharing` (Boolean) Enable load-balancing across VIOSes. Requires `secondary_vios` to be configured and at least one `load_group` entry. Can be toggled on or off while the bridge is active.
- `primary_vios` (Block, Optional) Primary VIOS for the NetworkBridge SEA. Required. `name` is **immutable** (forces replacement). `backing_adapter` can be swapped in-place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sea--primary_vios))
- `qos_mode` (String) Quality-of-service mode on the SEA (`"disabled"` | `"strict"` | `"loose"`).
- `secondary_vios` (Block, Optional) Secondary VIOS for SEA failover. Adding `secondary_vios` automatically enables failover, `failover` is computed and cannot be set directly. Must be included at resource creation time, cannot be added to or removed from an existing bridge without recreating the resource. `name` is **immutable**. `backing_adapter` can be changed in-place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sea--secondary_vios))

Read-Only:

- `bridge_id` (String) UUID of the NetworkBridge assigned by the HMC (computed).
- `failover` (Boolean) Whether SEA failover is enabled (read-only, computed). Automatically `true` when `secondary_vios` is configured. Cannot be set directly, add or remove `secondary_vios` to control failover.
- `pvid` (Number) Bridge Port VLAN ID (PVID). Computed from the untagged virtual network's VLAN ID. Read-only.

<a id="nestedatt--sea--load_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sea.load_group`

Required:

- `pvid` (Number) PortVLANID for this load group. Changing this value destroys the existing load group and creates a new one.

Optional:

- `primary_slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the primary VIOS within this load group. Optional, when omitted the HMC assigns a slot automatically. Changing this value destroys the existing load group and creates a new one.
- `secondary_slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the secondary VIOS within this load group. Only valid when `secondary_vios` is configured. Optional, when omitted the HMC assigns a slot automatically. Changing this value destroys the existing load group and creates a new one.
- `vlan_ids` (Set of Number) Set of virtual network VLAN IDs (vlan_id) to assign to this load group. Each value must correspond to a `vlan_id` in the `virtual_network` list. Each value must be unique across all load groups. Virtual networks removed from this set are moved to the default load group.


<a id="nestedblock--sea--primary_vios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sea.primary_vios`

Optional:

- `backing_adapter` (String) Physical Ethernet adapter on the VIOS (e.g. `ent5`). Can be changed in-place.
- `high_availability_mode` (String) HA mode of the backing SEA as reported by the HMC (`"disabled"` | `"auto"` | `"standby"` | `"sharing"`). Always `(known after apply)`, the HMC recomputes this from `failover` / `load_sharing` flags after every apply. Not settable on create. Can be set on update to request a specific mode; the HMC may override it based on bridge flags.
- `name` (String) VIOS partition name. **Immutable**, forces replacement if changed.
- `slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the VIOS. **Immutable**, forces replacement if changed.

Read-Only:

- `adapter_id` (Number) Numeric adapter ID of the backing device (read-only, from HMC).
- `description` (String) Description of the backing adapter (read-only, from HMC).
- `physical_location` (String) Physical location code of the backing adapter (read-only, from HMC).


<a id="nestedblock--sea--secondary_vios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sea.secondary_vios`

Optional:

- `backing_adapter` (String) Physical Ethernet adapter on the VIOS (e.g. `ent6`). Can be changed in-place.
- `high_availability_mode` (String) HA mode of the backing SEA as reported by the HMC (`"disabled"` | `"auto"` | `"standby"` | `"sharing"`). Always `(known after apply)`, the HMC recomputes this from `failover` / `load_sharing` flags after every apply. Not settable on create. Can be set on update to request a specific mode; the HMC may override it based on bridge flags.
- `name` (String) VIOS partition name. **Immutable**, forces replacement if changed.
- `slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number for the trunk adapter on the VIOS. **Immutable**, forces replacement if changed.

Read-Only:

- `adapter_id` (Number) Numeric adapter ID of the backing device (read-only, from HMC).
- `description` (String) Description of the backing adapter (read-only, from HMC).
- `physical_location` (String) Physical location code of the backing adapter (read-only, from HMC).



<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Notes

### Finding a free backing adapter

Before configuring `sea.primary_vios.backing_adapter` or `sea.secondary_vios.backing_adapter`,
use the [`powerhmc_vios`](../data-sources/vios.md) data source to discover which physical
Ethernet adapters are free and available as SEA backing devices on a VIOS:

```terraform
data "powerhmc_vios" "vios1" {
  system_name = "managed-system"
  vios_name   = "vios1"
}

# free_sea_devices lists all unattached Ethernet adapters on the VIOS.
output "free_adapters" {
  value = data.powerhmc_vios.vios1.free_sea_devices
}
```

Each entry in `free_sea_devices` contains `device_name` (e.g. `ent0`) and
`physical_location`. Use `device_name` as the value for `backing_adapter`.

### Virtual networks and the bridge PVID

Exactly one `virtual_network` entry must have `tagged = false`. The untagged virtual network becomes the bridge PVID. All other virtual networks must have `tagged = true`.

### SEA failover

`secondary_vios` does not support in-place updates. To enable SEA failover,
include a `secondary_vios` block when creating the `sea` block, it cannot be
added to an already-deployed bridge without recreating the resource, removing
`secondary_vios` also requires recreation.

The `failover` attribute is computed, it cannot be set directly. It reflects
whether a secondary VIOS is attached to the bridge.

### Load sharing

Load sharing distributes VLAN traffic across both VIOSes. It requires both
`secondary_vios` and at least one `load_group` entry inside `sea`. Use
`sea.load_group[*].vlan_ids` to map specific VLAN IDs to a load group; VLANs
not listed go to the default load group automatically.

### Immutable attributes

The following attributes force destroy-and-recreate if changed:

- `sea.jumbo_frame`
- `sea.primary_vios.name`
- `sea.secondary_vios.name`
- `sea.primary_vios.slot_number` (if configured)
- `sea.secondary_vios.slot_number` (if configured)
- `sea.load_group[*].pvid`
- `sea.load_group[*].primary_slot_number` (if configured)
- `sea.load_group[*].secondary_slot_number` (if configured)
- `system_name`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Network bridges are imported using the managed system name and bridge PVID,
# separated by a forward slash: <system_name>/<bridge_pvid>
terraform import powerhmc_network_bridge.basic managed-system/100
```
